hero.title: Drink Smart. Spend Smarter. Romania's First Financial Education Bar.
hero.description: A place where friendship and financial literacy meet to shape a better future.

network.title: Network
network.description: Surround yourself with people who think critically, invest wisely, and love talking numbers.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Understand financial markets not from theory, but from the bar—where prices move with the crowd.

enjoy.title: Enjoy the Vibe
enjoy.description: Real-time pricing means real opportunities—enjoy drinks at their best price, just like a savvy investor would.

solution.title: A Bar Where the Market Comes to Life
solution.description: At this bar, you're not just ordering drinks—you're participating in a live simulation of the market. Prices change based on customer consumption, giving you a hands-on understanding of how real-time demand drives value. It's finance made fun, shared with good friends and good vibes.

financial_literacy.title: Financial Literacy
financial_literacy.description: According to EU, Romania faces a significant gap in financial education. Investo Bar is here to change that—making finance accessible, social, and engaging.

network.title: Community
network.description: An experience that blends social energy with professional growth. At Investo Bar, you don’t just meet people—you meet potential. A place where ideas are born and industries take shape.

about.title: When an entrepreneur, lawyer, economist and engineer want to help their community grow smarter, stronger, and more connected.
about.description: By coming together, enjoying great moments, and learning how financial markets really work.
